sentences.text: Researchers tested whether delivering the Gsx1 gene via a viral vector into the spinal cord of animals with contusion injuries aids recovery.
Animals receiving this treatment displayed improved movement skills and sensitivity to touch relative to untreated counterparts.
Early after injury, the intervention induced cells lining the spinal cord to revert to a primitive, stem-cell-like state while steering precursor cells toward forming nerve insulation.
Over the long term, the spinal cord exhibited a shift in nerve cell composition favoring types that send activating signals, including a notable increase in cells using glutamate.
Blocking a specific gene in precursor cells diminished the treatment's impact on both cellular changes and movement recovery.
